purpose: Permanent JANUS corpus layer for exact mechanisms relevant to the R5 E8 6I induced-algebra / weak-relaxation coverage frontier.

strategic_context.missing_object: Polynomial exact preprocessing/coverage bridge into a source-bound tractable induced-algebra layer without encoding the SAT witness.

materials.title: On the induced problem for fixed-template CSPs
materials.janus_takeaway: Separates certificate discovery from solving given a certificate. For Boolean Bwnu, the induced prototype layer is tractable but direct 3-SAT coverage fails; maximal Siggers certificate expressiveness can make prototype discovery NP-hard.

materials.title: An Algebraic Approach to Multi-sorted Constraints
materials.janus_takeaway: Different variable sorts can legitimately use different algebraic behavior while relations remain compatible. This is a source precedent for instance-specific compositional algebra rather than one global Schaefer operation.

materials.title: Domain permutation reduction for constraint satisfaction problems
materials.janus_takeaway: Variable-specific domain permutations can expose tractable structure, but finding them is itself the key complexity question. On Boolean domains some permutation-discovery problems are polynomial.
materials.janus_barrier: Boolean id/not occurrence reformulation with EQ/NEQ synchronization has now been theorem-level shown not to expand B4 coverage.

materials.title: The Dichotomy for Conservative Constraint Satisfaction is Polynomially Decidable
materials.janus_takeaway: Positive control that nontrivial algebraic tractability structure can sometimes be discovered in polynomial time rather than merely verified.

materials.title: Effectiveness of Structural Restrictions for Hybrid CSPs
materials.janus_takeaway: Shows how structural restrictions on the instance side can be translated into lifted constraint languages and analyzed algebraically; key source lineage behind the all-Siggers induced control.

materials.title: Graphs of relational structures: restricted types
materials.janus_takeaway: Local pair structure can be classified by semilattice/majority/affine behavior, and edge-type restrictions connect to bounded width and few-subpowers algorithms.
materials.janus_use: Method donor for a richer local certificate whose interaction compatibility is explicit rather than one global operation.

materials.title: Weaker consistency notions for all the CSPs of bounded width
materials.janus_takeaway: Strong positive control for what local consistency can solve when the target language has bounded width. Does not cover arbitrary 3-SAT; NAE3 already blocks simple B4 local-consistency rescue.

materials.title: Implementing a Test for Tractability
materials.janus_takeaway: Older exact mechanism for turning polymorphism/tractability tests into explicit CSP-like indicator problems; useful conceptual precursor to induced certificate discovery, not a universal SAT algorithm.

materials.title: Binary vs. non-binary constraints
materials.janus_takeaway: Exact lifted-domain encodings can preserve satisfiability while changing representation; arc consistency on the hidden-variable encoding is equivalent in inferential power to the original nonbinary formulation, warning that naive tuple-domain lifting may only repackage the same difficulty.
